title: Remove legacy domain checks when migration completes
description:
## Context

Two legacy domains are included in the diagnostic checks but are scheduled for removal once the Academy platform migration is complete:

- `posit.academy` — old campsite domain
- `rsacdn.link` — Academy CDN

## Current usage in academyTutorials

### rsacdn.link
Still actively used in:
- `_quarto.yml` files: `https://rsacdn.link/teachthis/css/style.css` (teachthis stylesheet)
- Tutorial data files (e.g., functions, state management, missing values tutorials)
- `support.qmd`: teachthis stylesheet reference

### posit.academy
- The `*.posit.academy` campsite domain is the old learner portal

## Action items

- [ ] Monitor `rstudio/academyTutorials` for removal of `rsacdn.link` references
- [ ] Monitor for retirement of the `posit.academy` campsite domain
- [ ] When both are confirmed retired, remove their checks from this diagnostic page
- [ ] Update the domain count and category sections accordingly
